name: Crudel

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Crudel is a hero of the Arthurian stories, shown as a pagan king. Joseph of Arimathea, a Jewish merchant, reached Britain bearing the Grail, the vessel Jesus Christ used at his final meal. Crudel met him and threw the visitor into prison. Christian warriors later set Joseph free.

okr.objective: Crudel is the pagan king who imprisoned Joseph of Arimathea when he brought the Grail to Britain.
